modalLead: A custom widget keeps its figures up to date on its own, without the page being reloaded.

items.text: A custom widget refreshes itself. It was the one tile that reads from a service of your own, and the only way to see a newer figure was to reload the page — so a dashboard left open all day showed the download speed it found at breakfast. Each custom tile now keeps its own clock, set by How long an answer keeps in its settings: 60 seconds for a download speed, five minutes for a queue, an hour for something measured hourly. Nothing to switch on, and the presets already carry a sensible figure per service. While the tab is in the background nothing is asked at all, so a dashboard on a second monitor does not spend the day questioning your own machines.
